faq.title: FAQ — draft()
faq.desc: Answers about draft(): what it is, who makes it, how it works, privacy, pricing and release status.
items: What is draft()?

draft() is a private AI app that turns what you say out loud into a finished, shareable story. You talk for about thirty seconds, draft() asks two or three gentle questions, and then it shapes your words into a story: hook, rising action, peak, reflection and close.
Who makes draft()?
draft() is an app from ipe Studio, the studio behind ipe(). The umbrella site is [ipe.rest](https://ipe.rest); this site, draft.ipe.rest, is the official site for draft().
Is draft() the same as Draft AI or other apps called Draft?
No. Several apps and tools share the name “Draft”. draft() — written with parentheses — is a voice-first storytelling app by ipe Studio. See [About](/about/) for how to tell them apart.
How does it work?
Three turns. Just talk — rambling and half-sentences are fine. draft() asks a few questions to find the real moment. Then you get a finished story, from hook to close, ready to post.
Which devices does it run on?
draft() is an iOS app.
Is draft() available now?
draft() is still being prepared for iOS. We will announce the App Store release on this site. Until then, please treat the app as not yet released.
What will it cost?

The home page shows a free way to try it — three finished stories, no account needed — and a monthly subscription (shown as $2.99 per month) for unlimited stories. The price is confirmed at launch. Final prices and terms are shown on the App Store. The 3-day free trial requires a payment method, and when the trial ends it converts automatically to a paid subscription. There are no free features after the trial ends.
Which languages are supported?

This website is available in 11 languages: English, 한국어, 日本語, 中文, Español, Português, Bahasa Indonesia, Русский, Tiếng Việt, Français, Deutsch. Which languages the app supports will be confirmed at launch.
Are my words private?

Your words are yours — never sold, never used to train. You decide what is kept and what is deleted, and only the finished story is shared, when you choose to. Details are on the [Privacy](/privacy/) page.
How do I get help?
A support contact will be published on this page when the app launches. Until then, the pages on this site are the place for answers.

about.title: About draft() — and how it differs from other Draft apps
about.desc: draft() by ipe Studio is a voice-first storytelling app. How it differs from other apps that share the name Draft.

p: Many apps and tools use the name “Draft” — for example Draft AI, a carousel post maker. draft() on this site is a different product: a voice-first storytelling app made by ipe Studio. You talk for about thirty seconds, answer two or three gentle questions, and get a finished story — hook, rising action, peak, reflection and close — while your words stay yours.

privacy.title: Privacy — draft()
privacy.desc: How draft() and draft.ipe.rest handle your data: what we promise, what is still being finalized, and how this website works.

sections.h: In the app: still being finalized
p: draft() is still being prepared, so some details are not final, and we will not guess here. Before launch we will confirm each of these and publish them on this page:
li: How your speech is turned into text, and whether that happens on your device or with a service.
How long stories and drafts are kept, and how you delete them.
What usage statistics the app collects, if any.
How subscriptions and payments are handled through the App Store.
How to contact us about your data.
Visits are counted with Cloudflare Web Analytics, which is cookieless and does not collect personal data.
Fonts load from Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google’s font servers.
Your language choice, and whether you closed the language hint, are remembered in your browser only (local storage) and are never sent to us.
There are no accounts on this site, and it collects no forms or personal details.

p: A contact address for privacy questions will be published here at launch.
